wins: Detailed reconnaissance produced a prioritized asset list and service inventory for the target network, enabling focused follow-up actions.
Mentor calls documented precise mitigation hypotheses, improving the situational narrative despite the overall failed run.
fails: Zero successful episodes: exploitation chain collapsed at the privilege escalation phase after valid SSH credentials were never obtained.
Persistent inability to pivot to the secondary subnet prevented access to high-value assets and achievement of mission goals.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance succeeded in cataloguing assets and services, but exploitation efforts stalled due to missing credentials and pivot capability, resulting in no successful completions.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Failure to escalate privileges because valid SSH credentials were absent and no alternative vector was pursued.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with nmap scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service (port 80/443) returns Apache/nginx banner
skill_cards.then_action: Execute nikto and gobuster for directory enumeration, then pivot to CVE lookup

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH login fails multiple times and SSH enumeration revealed valid users
skill_cards.then_action: Search for credential artifacts from open shares or leaked configuration files before brute forcing

memory_ops.reason: SSH enumeration reliably produced key user and method data in reconnaissance phase.

next_experiments.title: Expand credential harvesting pathways
next_experiments.description: Integrate automated parsing of SMB shares and config files identified during recon to find reusable credentials before attempting SSH brute force.

next_experiments.title: Develop fallback pivot tactic
next_experiments.description: Prepare a pivot plan using identified HTTP services and stored XSS/CORS vectors to access secondary subnet if SSH escalation is blocked.
